extracted.name: Barbecue sauce
extracted.description: Learn how to make superb homemade BBQ sauce and wow your garden party guests with our easy recipe – it's incredibly moreish
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a saucepan and add the onion. Cook over a gentle heat 4-5 mins, until softened. Add the remaining ingredients, season and mix. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-30 mins, until thickened. For a smooth sauce, simply whizz the mixture in a food processor or with a hand blender for a few seconds.
